services.desc: Create your own neighborhood map!Go on a mini walking tour of the Museum’s neighborhood.Make a communal map of the neighborhood based on what you remember. Cut out different types of Somerville homes and buildings, and design a map of your neighborhood!Wear comfy shoes. Perfect for Pre-K - 5 By the summer of 1774, Massachusetts was slipping out of British control. Hoping to reverse the trend, General Gage sent a small force up the Mystic River to seize the province’s remaining gunpowder. That mission nearly sparked the American Revolution-eight months before the march to Lexington.
